caseData.headline: Likely: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments

findings.plain: money from lenders or linked companies is arriving dressed up as customer payments
invoices are fake, inflated or altered
the reported financial statements don't fit the evidence
the borrower has debt it has not disclosed
the borrower is connected to undisclosed shell companies

signals.explanation: 61 invoice numbers were submitted more than once with different amounts (up to 24.7x the original)
Revenue sent to Wells Fargo for Q7 is +26% off what the borrower reported to the SEC for the same quarter (4 quarters differ)
'Silverline Credit Fund LP' holds a lien on a related company ('Tidewater Receivables LLC': inventory and proceeds) that the borrower never disclosed
The borrower's own SEC filings (10-K debt footnote, 8-K Item 2.03) name 'Silverline Credit Fund LP' as a lender, but that debt was never disclosed to Wells Fargo
Reported receivables are 30.1x their usual size relative to revenue (2 quarters in a row): money is booked that isn't being collected
$10,388,351 (7.2% of inflows) arrived as 'customer' cash from 'Tidewater Receivables LLC', an undisclosed company linked to the borrower
6 of 15 invoice documents show a different total from the borrower's data (read twice by the document model)
Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported
Debt reported to Wells Fargo omits 2 secured lender(s) found in public lien filings
Reported revenue is running 26% above what verified customer cash supports (2 quarters in a row)
'Tidewater Receivables LLC' looks like a shell: no operations, same address as borrower, no LEI / not in GLEIF
'Tidewater Trade Services LLC' looks like a shell: no operations, same address as borrower, no LEI / not in GLEIF
107 invoices are over 5x what the named customer normally pays
14.9% of invoices past due were never paid by the named customer (128 of 861)
Reported receivables include invoices that S4 found altered, unpaid or implausible
Undisclosed related company 'Tidewater Receivables LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address
Undisclosed related company 'Tidewater Trade Services LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address and phone number
Covenant metric landed within 5% above the threshold two quarters running
